description: Probe-only rejection library for hipkernel:Gfx950AttentionDense (rocKE dense attention, forward SDPA, gfx950): a legal graph the engine ships (BSHD, head size 64 or 128, bf16 or half, a (Hq, Hkv) pair the KDP ships for that head size, seqlen_q a multiple of 128, seqlen_kv a multiple of 32, scale 0.0883883, declared alignment 16) with ONE feature per case, named by the `family` axis (the base shape is the `shape` axis, a [dtype, B, Hq, Hkv, Sq, Skv, head size] tuple of shipped combinations, and the `odd` axis carries the per-family odd values); every family is a graph the frontend accepts. `expect` is `declined` where the engine must not take the graph (the kernel has no input for the feature or a stated unsupported configuration, so an accept computes something else) and `declined_or_pass` where a correct engine may take it (then it must be right). Lines cited are in dnn-providers/hip-kernel-provider/src/engines/kernel_ingestor_engine/packs/Gfx950AttentionDenseNative.cpp, gfx950AttentionDenseGraphMatches unless noted. The engine runs on gfx950 (the only device available), so every family can be run on a device; the engine needs HIPKERNELPROVIDER_ENABLE_ROCKE and the gfx950_attention_dense KDP pulled. none: control, a plain graph the engine takes. odd_sq: seqlen_q not a multiple of 128 (1, 3, 63, 127, 129, ...), odd or not divisible by 4; the kernel matcher requires Sq % block_m == 0 (tileDivides, line 883-886), a limitation a correct engine may lift: declined_or_pass. odd_skv: seqlen_kv not a multiple of 32 (tileDivides, line 885): declined_or_pass. odd_head_size: head size 8, 32, 63, 96, 126, 129, 130, 192, 256: not divisible by 4 or not 64/128 (line 593; AttentionDenseSpec.__post_init__): declined_or_pass. unshipped_heads: (Hq, Hkv) pairs the KDP does not ship for the head size (the pairs shipped only at the other head size, and odd pairs such as (3, 3), (5, 1), (7, 7), (6, 2); kernel matcher lines 944-949): declined_or_pass. kv_heads_differ: V has a different head count than K (both divide Hq, which the frontend allows); V shares K's base and stride in the builder, so line 546-549 declines: `declined`. v_head_size: V and O head size differ from Q and K (64 vs 128); one head size per kernel, lines 546-549 and 566-569: `declined`. dt_q_other, dt_k_other, dt_v_other, dt_o_other: one of Q, K, V, O in the other 16-bit type (bf16 vs half); line 528-536 requires one dtype for Q, K, V and O, and an accepted graph would read or write the buffer as the wrong type: `declined`. dt_o_float: float O with 16-bit inputs, same line 528: `declined`. dt_all_float: all four fp32; line 537-543 (no fp32 kernel is built) but a correct engine may add one: declined_or_pass. attn_mask (additive bias, line 669), scale_tensor (device-resident scale tensor, line 677), scale_tensor_value (pass-by-value scale tensor, the same line 677), seq_len_q and seq_len_kv (one tensor each, line 685), padding (padding_mask with both seq_len tensors, lines 685 and 753), dropout_philox (dropout_probability 0.1 with seed and offset, line 694), dropout_zero (dropout_probability 0.0 alone: any dropout field declines, even zero, line 697, stricter than ASM), dropout_mask (explicit mask and scale tensors, line 695-696), rng_dump (dropout plus an rng_dump output, lines 694 and 739), paged_kv (page tables and max_seq_len_kv, with a single 64-row block so K and V keep a dense shape and only paging differs; also needs seq_len tensors, so line 685 declines too, line 703), block_mask (line 712), sink (line 717), descale_qkv (descale_q/k/v, line 724), fp8_softmax_scales (descale_s, scale_s, scale_o, amax_s, amax_o, line 727-729), stats (stats tensor with generate_stats, line 737-740), stats_no_flag (stats tensor with generate_stats unset, line 737), row_stats (stats, max and sum_exp, line 737-738), alibi (alibi_mask, line 748): all `declined`, the kernel computes dense attention only and would drop the feature. bottom_right: bottom-right causal with seqlen_q != seqlen_kv; the kernel's causal clamp is top-left, line 650-656: `declined`. sliding_window: left_bound 64 with right_bound 0; no shipped variant carries a window (maskTypeFor, line 364-370; comment 318-319): declined_or_pass. scale_neg: attn_scale_value -0.125; the row max is taken on unscaled scores, valid only for a positive scale (isSupportedAttentionScale, line 392-399): `declined`. scale_big (32) and scale_tiny (2**-70) are outside [2^-64, 2^4] only because of the fma rounding residue of the kernel (line 785-791): declined_or_pass. implementation_composite and implementation_unified: `implementation` is an execution-strategy hint and the engine only takes AUTO (line 774); a hint a fused kernel can honour: declined_or_pass. mma_float and mma_fp8: mma_core_mode other than UNSET, HALF, BFLOAT16 (allow-list, line 764-766); the MFMA operands are the graph's own 16-bit inputs: declined_or_pass. overflow: `ovf` names one 32-bit addressing limit pushed past the bound at enforcement_level buildable (no tensor is allocated, filled or executed): K or V of 2**31 bytes or more (kv_seq: Skv = 2**23, kv_batch: B = 2**14, kv_heads: Hkv = 2**16, kv_int64: the byte product itself overflows int64, checkedProduct, lines 605-613), Q or O of 2**31 elements or more (q_seq: Sq = 2**24, q_seq_u32: Sq = 2**32, q_batch: B = 2**17, q_heads: Hq = 2**17, q_int64: the element product overflows int64 while K stays under 2**31 bytes, lines 614-622). Strides are the exact dense BSHD strides of the huge dims. `expect` is `declined`: the kernel addresses K/V with 32-bit byte offsets and Q/O with 32-bit element offsets. An accepted and built overflow case is reported `UNEXERCISED` with the reason `accepted above the oracle ceiling`. No family is a known gap: every one of the cited lines exists, a decline is expected everywhere it is stated. The space is probe-only and never frozen into a bundle.

derive.heads: (odd[3] if d == 64 else odd[4]) if family == 'unshipped_heads' else [shape[2], shape[3]]
derive.sq_e: ovf[4] if ov else (odd[0] if family == 'odd_sq' else shape[4])
derive.skv_e: ovf[5] if ov else (odd[1] if family == 'odd_skv' else (64 if family == 'paged_kv' else (shape[5] + 32 if (family == 'bottom_right' and shape[5] == shape[4]) else shape[5])))
derive.dqk: ovf[6] if ov else (odd[2] if family == 'odd_head_size' else d)
derive.dv: (64 if dqk == 128 else 128) if family == 'v_head_size' else dqk
derive.hv: (1 if hkv == hq else hq) if family == 'kv_heads_differ' else hkv
derive.dtq: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_q_other' else dtype)
derive.dtk: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_k_other' else dtype)
derive.dtv: 'float' if family == 'dt_all_float' else (other if family == 'dt_v_other' else dtype)
derive.dto: 'float' if family in ['dt_all_float', 'dt_o_float'] else (other if family == 'dt_o_other' else dtype)
derive.scale_value: None if family in ['scale_tensor', 'scale_tensor_value'] else (-0.125 if family == 'scale_neg' else (32.0 if family == 'scale_big' else (8.470329472543003e-22 if family == 'scale_tiny' else 0.0883883461356163)))
